description: A starter hint that builds a minimal static site and deploys it to Pages, sharing the preview URL for review.

steps.description: This hint deploys a static site to Pages. It is for the case where you have no existing build output.

`mkdir my-site` creates a directory, and `echo "

CS357 Project Demo

" > my-site/index.html` writes a minimal `index.html`. The comment calls this the minimal example.
`npx wrangler pages deploy ./my-site --project-name=cs357-yourname` publishes the directory to Pages.
The comment notes the output includes a unique preview URL, and that you share that URL for review rather than the production URL.
